_note: Candidate registry for Maine 2026. Every record comes from the state's official list of candidates for the November 3, 2026 general election (Maine Department of the Secretary of State, Bureau of Corporations, Elections and Commissions, 2026 General Election Candidates List (FINAL, November 3, 2026; file last modified September 9, 2026), linked in source_url; a race from another official list links it in roster_source_url). Names and party labels are as the list prints them (mixed case where the list prints capitals). Nothing in a record is invented: no bios, photos, websites or fundraising.
_source: Maine Department of the Secretary of State, Bureau of Corporations, Elections and Commissions, 2026 General Election Candidates List (FINAL, November 3, 2026; file last modified September 9, 2026) (https://www.maine.gov/sos/sites/maine.gov.sos/files/inline-files/2026%20General%20Candidate%20List%20-%20FINAL.xlsx); sitting members matched to congress.gov (bioguide_id).
